root_cause_candidate.finding: sec_ng_nav_extractor_v6.py already emits source_url, source_file, sheet/row evidence, currency and vl_price_source; import_vl_nigeria_sec.js drops source/type when grouping records, then explicitly writes null price_type/source_url/report_date.
root_cause_candidate.source_mapping: Carry source_url from the chosen extractor record into the grouped VL item.
root_cause_candidate.report_date_rule: Carry only an actual published/report date if the extractor exports one. Do not substitute valuation_date.
root_cause_candidate.sec_document_id_rule: Remain NULL unless an actual official document identifier is available.

decisions.rationale: It can improve qualification without changing the numeric VL, NAV, fund match or currency choice.
Morocco/Tunisia/UEMOA/CEMAC need adapters to their existing evidence or future acquisition metadata; zero coverage cannot be repaired by guessed URLs.
Recent Nigeria rows can have data_quality=UNQUALIFIED even while downstream series length/alignment would pass Allocation preparation.

promotion_candidate.title: Nigeria SEC — transport extractor provenance and explicit price type into canonical valuation contract
scope_files: sec_ng_nav_extractor_v6.py (read-only source contract unless export naming needs a compatibility alias)
src/lib/vl_contract.js tests/fixtures only if mapping needs explicit normalization helper
tests: CSV row with unit_price + source_url maps to UNIT_PRICE and keeps same numeric VL.
offer_price_fallback maps to OFFER, bid_price_fallback maps to BID.
missing source remains UNQUALIFIED; no fabricated document ID/report date.
promotion_candidate.rollback: Code-only rollback before future imports; no historical data mutation in first rollout.
promotion_candidate.later_backfill: Historical metadata backfill, if desired, must be a separate evidence-driven task from retained source artifacts and exact row identity.

next_action: Measure current sec_ng_latest.csv transport readiness and then freeze exact patch contract for future promotion.
